title: 8 stencil-op color-probe oracle
purpose: Render an 8-cell 4x2 grid where each cell exercises one of the 8 NV2A stencil ops (KEEP/ZERO/REPLACE/INCRSAT/DECRSAT/INVERT/INCR/DECR). Per cell: clear stencil to 0x80, render an op-pass quad (color=BLACK, stencil func=ALWAYS, op applied to FAIL/ZFAIL/ZPASS, ref=0x40), then a probe quad with stencil func=EQUAL+ref=<expected post-op value>. The probe paints the cell's expected color (one of the 7 saturated RGB cube corners avoiding BLACK) when the post-op stencil matches the spec; if the op was mis-implemented the cell stays BLACK. Pure 0/255 RGB so byte-exact across renderers regardless of display gamma. v1 plan's Tier-2 readback proposal was rejected (Codex finding #7) because Metal's surface-download path skips the stencil aspect; this color-probe redesign keeps the verdict inside the visible drawable. Per the §4.10 spec, the chosen initial stencil 0x80 is intentionally in the no-overflow region for INCRSAT/DECRSAT/INCR/DECR; a separate XBE will exercise the saturation boundary at 0xFF/0x00. **FIRST RUN ON METAL (2026-05-20 evening, latest): exposed a real Metal stencil-op correctness gap.** Cells KEEP, INCRSAT, DECRSAT, DECR rendered BLACK on Metal; ZERO, REPLACE, INVERT, INCR rendered correctly. Marked expected_fail on Metal pending the renderer fix (task tracked outside this manifest). GL and real-Xbox cells are expected to PASS unchanged. When the Metal fix lands, remove `metal` from expected_fail_renderers.
